blocks.text: Software debugging and testing are critical stages of software development that ensure the quality and reliability of a software product. Effective debugging and testing help developers confirm that the software meets the required specifications, functions as intended and is free of critical errors.

blocks.prompt: What do debugging and testing confirm about a software product?
blocks.explanation: That it meets the required specifications, works as intended and has no critical errors, so that it is of good quality and reliable.

items: Debugging and testing: critical stages ensuring quality and reliability; confirm specifications are met, the software works and critical errors are gone.
